title: Autoscale Command Center: Presets, Throughput Telemetry, and Change Chronicle
creator: Omar Ruiz
description:
Goal: Deliver a unified 'Autoscale Command Center' within Console that exposes curated autoscale presets (throughput SLAs, min/max pool, cooldowns), a live throughput telemetry pane (per-fleet and per-model throughput, percentile latency, queued request count), and an auditable change chronicle (who changed what, before/after, rollback shortcut).

Background: Customers running Dedicated pools ask for predictable throughput SLAs while keeping unit costs controlled. Current console surfaces rudimentary scaling knobs and a sparse audit log; we need a consolidated UX to (1) simplify common scaling policies, (2) surface telemetry tied to guarantee tiers, and (3) provide safe operational controls for rollbacks and canarying.

Scope: UX for presets + preset editor, throughput dashboard widgets (last 24h, 7d, overlay SLO bands), change chronicle with rich diffs, a one-click rollback action that triggers guardrails and an ENG API to execute rollbacks.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Users can select a named autoscale preset (e.g., "throughput-guarantee-8k", "cost-optimized-eco") when editing a fleet and preview expected capacity curves.
2) Telemetry panel shows per-fleet throughput (rps), 50/95/99 latency percentiles, active queued requests, and effective batch sizes. Data refresh interval defaults to 5s and supports 1s for on-demand troubleshooting.
3) Change Chronicle records every modification to scaling knobs (who, timestamp, before/after JSON, optional comment) and provides a sortable table + diff view.
4) Rollback button re-applies the previous active scale policy and opens a canary dialog (percentage of traffic, duration). Rollback requires two-step confirmation and is gated by RBAC role 'fleet-admin'.
5) Backend endpoints in ENG backlog (ENG-8842, ENG-9120) implemented and returning stable telemetry and audit events. Console uses those endpoints with proper pagination and rate limits.
6) Unit and integration tests for preset editor, telemetry rendering, and rollback flow. Security review completed prior to GA (console-2026.03).

Non-goals: Full SLO enforcement engine (out of scope for this ticket), historical metric reprocessing beyond 90 days.
comments: 2026-02-23 — Kickoff: scoping session with Eng (lead: Priya Patel) and Design (lead: Lucas Nguyen). Agreed to ship presets + telemetry + chronicle in single thin-slice for visibility. Omar to own PRD.

2026-03-01 — Design review: prototypes v1 shared. Feedback: add explicit SLO band overlays and a compact card for active autoscale policy. Action: Design to iterate; ENG to estimate API changes (ENG-8842).

2026-03-04 — ENG sync: Backend team estimates 6 points to add audit event stream and telemetry endpoints (depends on ENG-9120 for KV cache metrics). ENG requested schema for 'before/after' diffs; PM to provide.
2026-03-07 — Security: SSO/RBAC constraints reviewed. Security requires explicit audit retention policy and encryption-at-rest for audit payloads. Marked ticket security_review_required=true.
2026-03-10 — Design v2 uploaded: added rollback confirmation modal, canary slider, and differential preview. Link to Figma in Links section. Starting frontend spike to wire mock data.

2026-03-12 — Implementation: Frontend has basic presets UI and telemetry mock connected. Backend stub endpoints returning sample timeseries available under ENG-8842 branch feature/autoscale-telemetry. Next: integrate real telemetry and implement audit pagination.
